author: GamingBolt
description:
The Witcher 3 launched in 2015, and still holds up pretty well by today's standards. But CD Projekt RED is aiming higher with the remaster, essentially making it so that you won't want to go back to the original. 

How much of that will apply to the visuals, especially after the Next-Gen Update from 2022 brought the game up to a pretty strong standard? Let's find out, but first, it's important to ask...
title: How Does The Witcher 3 Remastered Graphics Compare to the Original?

author: GamingBolt
description:
In a way, Minecraft Dungeons 2 feels like a redo of the first game – a clean slate of sorts. Except the same criticisms are stronger than ever. As much as you'd be willing to forgive a spin-off like this from a studio that isn't known for the genre in 2020, it's now six years later. 

Even if your expectations were low, Minecraft Dungeons 2 isn't in a hurry to meet them or overstay its welcome. It's just there, middling along, hoping the colorful scenery distracts you enough to disguise its utter barrenness. And quite frankly, this franchise deserves better.
title: Minecraft Dungeons 2 Review - The Final Verdict

author: GamingBolt
description:
The Witcher 3 Remastered could be easy to overlook thanks to it being a free update to a game that you’re quite familiar with already. But that would be ignoring a lot of meaningful changes that it brings to ensure that Geralt’s able to withstand the test of time with aplomb, making the final chapter of his saga one that you could continue to revisit for a while yet.

We’ve spent some time with The Continent’s new changes, and have come away impressed with the sheer confidence and polish that it now carries, making it an open world that goes toe to toe with the best ones in the business, Night City included. 

Geralt’s definitely worth joining forces with again, and his adventure now comes with some modern polish to make it even better than it already was.
title: The Witcher 3 Remastered Review - The Final Verdict
